snippet.title: Starsand Island | Full Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The full version of Starsand Island launches on August 18, 2026, at 5:00 AM PDT.

Version 1.0 introduces online multiplayer for up to four players, allowing you to farm, fish, build, explore, and enjoy island life together. The game will also launch on Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5, alongside the full release on PC and Xbox.

Since the Early Access launch in February, we've continued improving the game based on community feedback. We'd like to thank every islander who has supported us throughout this journey.

Version 1.0 is just the beginning. We'll continue bringing new content and improvements to Starsand Island in the future.
A limited-time launch discount will also be available.

See you on the island when Version 1.0 launches on August 18, 2026, at 5:00 AM PDT.
